Ordered 2.1 (deploy/freeze) -> 2.2 (migrate, THIS) -> 2.3 (accumulator rewire). 2.2 must land inside the in-flight totalWithdrawal Executable window [initiatedAt+24h, initiatedAt+72h] on the OLD DOLA/USDC strategies. broadcast.note: Broadcast variant runs the preview variant first (&&-chained) as a dry-run gate, then re-runs with --broadcast against a live Ledger. No --skip-simulation here (unlike ss-execute/ys-swap variants).

jsChain.note: 2.2 runs NO node scripts in either variant. It mutates no off-chain state: the script comment and patch-mainnet-addresses-saga2-deploy.js both confirm mainnet-addresses.ts is NOT touched by this step (no new deploys). Contrast: 2.1 wraps backup-mainnet-addresses.js + patch-mainnet-addresses-saga2-deploy.js; 2.3 wraps neither but repoints the accumulator in place.
